title: Clyde Tombaugh and Earth's small moons; gray motherships in orbit

tellings.quote: And he wrote he wrote an article, Tom Bar wrote an article saying that Earth had um some smaller moons orbiting at about 500 miles up.

plain: A scientist named Steve Coburn, on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, says that the astronomer Clyde Tombaugh wrote an article in the 1950s saying Earth had some small moons orbiting about 500 miles up. Coburn connects this to the idea of large grey alien 'motherships' sitting in orbit. If true, it would mean big unknown craft have been circling Earth for a long time.
